usedFor: Recall.ai transcribes meetings and Conversion Chats handles messaging, so “New Transcript Completed” can alert someone via “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transcript Completed” in Recall.ai, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A finished transcript triggers a template message to your team, sent through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: “New Transcript Completed” is polling, so “Send Template Message” goes out after a scheduled check, not at the meeting’s end.
